name: mia-desktop-app
author: Nguyễn Đức Huy
description: MIA WT local desktop client for mia-crawl-service

scripts.dev:electron: cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && node scripts/launch-electron.mjs ."
scripts.check:electron: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/external-url-policy.cjs && node --check electron/app-logger.cjs && node --check electron/device-identity.cjs && node --check electron/license/legacy-formulas.cjs && node --check electron/license/legacy-detector.cjs && node --check electron/license/hardware-profile.cjs && node --check electron/license/license-api.cjs && node --check electron/license/license-manager.cjs && node --check electron/license/protected-license-store.cjs && node --check electron/security-policy.cjs && node --check electron/account-connection-broker.cjs && node --check electron/local-account-broker.cjs && node --check electron/job-lifecycle-broker.cjs && node --check electron/result-broker.cjs && node --check electron/artifact-file-broker.cjs && node --check electron/local-preferences.cjs && node --check electron/release-updater.cjs && node --check electron/python-runtime-client.cjs && node --check electron/offline-runtime-manager.cjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run check:electron && npm run check:runtime && npm run check:license-server && npm run check:offline-boundary && npm run test && npm run build:web && npm run check:renderer-bundle
scripts.prepare:runtime-browser: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=runtime/browsers python -m playwright install chromium
scripts.build:runtime:win: cross-env SETUPTOOLS_USE_DISTUTILS=local python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --distpath runtime/dist --workpath runtime/build runtime/mia-runtime.spec
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:runtime-builder && npm run prepare:runtime-browser && npm run build:runtime:win && npm run test:runtime:packaged && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && npm run scan:package
scripts.verify:all: npm run build && npm run test:visual
